title: Reading a Partial Record
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb N$, let $x$ be a finite binary input, let $d$ be a configuration of the $(k+2)$-work-tape record machine, and let $b$ be a Boolean record of width $4k+4$. Suppose $d$ starts in the record machine's initial state and the record tape contains $b$ at each of the next $4k+4$ cells from its head. For every $r\le 4k+4$, after $r$ steps the machine's configuration is exactly the configuration obtained from $d$ by storing the record position $r$ and the record whose entries before position $r$ are those of $b$ and whose remaining entries are false, and by advancing the record-tape head by $r$.
